source_of_truth: The real repo wins for code, docs, tasks, status, decisions, and test matrix.
conditional_reads: LLM-Wiki knowledge packs only when repo entry files or task packets trigger them
harness details only when the workflow card is insufficient
allowed_writes: repo source code and docs named by the task
repo task, status, and test-matrix files

forbidden_writes: code changes before checking task ownership and claim rules when present
approval_gates: request is not in the current task plan
architecture, data contract, permissions, deployment, or sensitive data boundary changes
write to live systems or raw source-of-truth data is proposed
evidence_before_done: repo test-matrix update or equivalent proof entry
separate LLM-Wiki file-back proposal if reusable knowledge was discovered
closeout_rules: if the user says stop or pause, run workflows/session-closeout.workflow.md for the active work target

drift_checks.description: Subordinate repo operating guides should preserve the real-repo workflow route required by repo entry files.
drift_checks.remediation: Update the subordinate guide read order so it includes the workflow catalog and real-repo workflow before repo-specific rules and task packet reads.
